# BB00232 {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the Most Unapproachable, the Most Holy

God testifieth that there is none other God but Him. His is the creation and the command. He giveth life and causeth death, then causeth death and giveth life, and verily He is the Ever-Living Who dieth not. Within His grasp lieth the kingdom of all things. He createth whatsoever He willeth by His command. Verily, He hath power over all things. [repeated 19 times]

God is the Most Exalted [repeated]

ʿAli, peace be upon him

God is the Most Exalted [repeated]

Fatimih, peace be upon her

God is the Most Exalted [repeated]

Muhammad, peace be upon him

God is the Most Exalted [repeated]

Hasan, peace be upon him

God is the Most Exalted [repeated]

Husayn, peace be upon Him

God is the Most Exalted [repeated]
